Public Function bGetTokenPhrase(ByRef sOrigStr As String, ByVal sPhrase As String, ByRef sTokenPhrase As String, Optional ByVal bDeleteFromList As Boolean = True) As Long
    Dim sStr As String
    Dim nTokenPhraseStart As Long
    Dim sTwoPercents As String

    sTwoPercents = Chr(37) & Chr(37)

    sStr = sOrigStr
    nTokenPhraseStart = InStr(UCase(sStr), UCase(sPhrase))
    If nTokenPhraseStart = 0 Then
     ' Phrase not present, return blank token phrase and False
       sTokenPhrase = ""
       Exit Function
    End If

    sStr = Trim(Mid(sStr, nTokenPhraseStart + Len(sPhrase)))
    
  ' The needed token is there
    bGetTokenPhrase = True

  ' Extract the proper Token phrase if available
    If Len(sStr) = 0 Then
       sTokenPhrase = ""
    ElseIf Left(sStr, 1) = "'" Then
       sStr = Mid(sStr, 2)
       sTokenPhrase = sExtractToken(sStr, 1, "'")
    ElseIf Left(sStr, 1) = "{" Then
       sStr = Mid(sStr, 2)
       sTokenPhrase = sExtractToken(sStr, 1, "}")
    ElseIf Left(sStr, 2) = sTwoPercents Then
       sStr = Mid(sStr, 3)
       sTokenPhrase = sExtractToken(sStr, 1, sTwoPercents)
    Else
       sTokenPhrase = ""
    End If

  ' Modify the incoming string without the returned token
    If bDeleteFromList Then
       If nTokenPhraseStart > 1 Then
          sOrigStr = Left(sOrigStr, nTokenPhraseStart - 1) & sStr
       Else
          sOrigStr = sStr
       End If
    End If

End Function

Public Function BrowseForFolder(ByVal hWndOwner As Long, ByVal sPrompt As String) As String
    Dim iNull As Integer
    Dim lpIDList As Long

' ***********************************************************************************
' Synopsis          Returns the number of tokens as delimited by siDelim
'
' Parameters
'
'   sAllTokens                 (I) Required. The string containing all the tokens
'   siDelim                     (I) Optional. The delimiter string that separates
'                                   the tokens. DEFAULT = " "
' Description
'  For the following:
'    sAllTokens         sDelim  Returns       Notes
'   "William M Rawls"    " "     3             "William", "M", and "Rawls"
'   "William M Rawls"    "iam"   2             "Will" and " M Rawls"
'   "William M Rawls"    ""      1             No delimiter? String has one token,
'                                              "William M Rawls"
'   "1.00.05"            "."     3             "1", "00", and "05"
' ***********************************************************************************
Public Function lTokenCount(ByVal sAllTokens As String, Optional ByVal siDelim As String = " ") As Long
    Static iCurTokenLocation As Long ' Character position of the first delimiter string
    Static iTokensSoFar As Integer      ' Used to keep track of how many tokens we've counted so far
    Static iDelim As Integer            ' Length of the delimiter string

    iDelim = Len(siDelim)
    If iDelim < 1 Then
     ' Empty delimiter strings means only one token equal to the string
       lTokenCount = 1
       Exit Function
    ElseIf Len(sAllTokens) = 0 Then
     ' Empty input string means no tokens
       Exit Function
    Else
     ' Count the number of tokens
       iTokensSoFar = 0
       Do
          iCurTokenLocation = InStr(sAllTokens, siDelim)
          If iCurTokenLocation = 0 Then
             lTokenCount = iTokensSoFar + 1 'Abs(Len(sAllTokens) > 0)
             Exit Function
          End If
          iTokensSoFar = iTokensSoFar + 1
          sAllTokens = Mid(sAllTokens, iCurTokenLocation + iDelim)
       Loop
    End If
End Function

' *********************************************************************************************
' Synopsis          Returns everything AFTER the Nth Token from sAllTokens delimited by sDelim
'
' Parameters
'
'   sAllTokens                 (I) Required. The string containing all the tokens
'   iToken                      (I) Optional. The index of the token to use as an "after" ref
'                                   DEFAULT = 1
'   siDelim                     (I) Optional. The delimiter string that separates
'                                   the tokens. DEFAULT = " "
' Description
'  For the following:
'    sAllTokens         iToken   sDelim  Returns           Notes
'   "William M Rawls"    1       " "     "M Rawls"          After the first word
'   "William M Rawls"    2       " "     "Rawls"            After the second word
'   "William M Rawls"    3       " "     ""                 After the third word (nothing)
'   "William M Rawls"    0       " "     "William M Rawls"  After zeroth token is always the input string
'   "William M Rawls"   -1       " "     "William M Rawls"  Negative tokens act same as zero
'   "William M Rawls"    1       ""      "William M Rawls"  Same as one
' *********************************************************************************************
Public Function sAfter(ByVal sAllTokens As String, Optional ByVal iToken As Integer = 1, Optional ByVal sDelim As String = " ") As String
    Static iCurTokenLocation As Long ' Character position of the first delimiter string
    Static nDelim As Integer            ' Length of the delimiter string
    
    nDelim = Len(sDelim)
    If iToken < 1 Or nDelim < 1 Then
     ' Negative or zeroth token or empty delimiter strings mean an empty token
       sAfter = sAllTokens
       Exit Function
    ElseIf iToken = 1 Then
     ' Quickly extract the first token
       iCurTokenLocation = InStr(sAllTokens, sDelim)
       If iCurTokenLocation > 1 Then
          sAfter = Mid(sAllTokens, iCurTokenLocation + nDelim)
          Exit Function
       ElseIf iCurTokenLocation = 0 Then
          sAfter = ""
          Exit Function
       Else
          sAfter = Mid(sAllTokens, nDelim + 1)
          Exit Function
       End If
    Else
     ' Find the Nth token
       Do
          iCurTokenLocation = InStr(sAllTokens, sDelim)
          If iCurTokenLocation = 0 Then
             Exit Function
          Else
             sAllTokens = Mid(sAllTokens, iCurTokenLocation + nDelim)
          End If
          iToken = iToken - 1
       Loop Until iToken = 1

     ' Extract the Nth token (Which is the next token at this point)
       iCurTokenLocation = InStr(sAllTokens, sDelim)
       If iCurTokenLocation > 0 Then
          sAfter = Mid(sAllTokens, iCurTokenLocation + nDelim)
          Exit Function
       Else
          Exit Function
       End If
    End If
End Function

' **********************************************************************************************
' Synopsis          Returns everything BEFORE the Nth Token from sAllTokens delimited by sDelim
'
' Parameters
'
'   sAllTokens                 (I) Required. The string containing all the tokens
'   iToken                      (I) Optional. The index of the token to use as a "before" ref
'                                   DEFAULT = 2
'   siDelim                     (I) Optional. The delimiter string that separates
'                                   the tokens. DEFAULT = " " (Space)
' Description
'  For the following:
'    sAllTokens         iToken   sDelim  Returns           Notes
'   "William M Rawls"    1       " "     ""                 Before the first word (nothing)
'   "William M Rawls"    2       " "     "William"          Before the second word
'   "William M Rawls"    3       " "     "William M"        Before the third word
'   "William M Rawls"    0       " "     ""                 Before zeroth token (nothing)
'   "William M Rawls"   -1       " "     ""                 Negative tokens act same as zero
'   "William M Rawls"    1       ""      ""                 Same as one
' *********************************************************************************************
Public Function sBefore(ByVal sAllTokens As String, Optional ByVal iToken As Integer = 2, Optional ByVal sDelim As String = " ") As String
    Static iCurTokenLocation As Long ' Character position of the first delimiter string
    Static nDelim As Integer            ' Length of the delimiter string
    Static sReturned As String

    nDelim = Len(sDelim)
    If iToken < 2 Or nDelim < 1 Then
     ' First, Zeroth, or Negative tokens or empty delimiter strings mean an empty string returned
       sBefore = ""
       Exit Function
    ElseIf iToken = 2 Then
     ' Quickly extract the first token
       sBefore = sGetToken(sAllTokens, 1, sDelim)
       Exit Function
    Else
     ' Find the Nth token
       Do
          iCurTokenLocation = InStr(sAllTokens, sDelim)
          If iCurTokenLocation = 0 Or iToken = 1 Then
             sBefore = sReturned
             sReturned = ""
             Exit Function
          ElseIf Len(sReturned) = 0 Then
             sReturned = Left(sAllTokens, iCurTokenLocation - 1)
          Else
             sReturned = sReturned & sDelim & Left(sAllTokens, iCurTokenLocation - 1)
          End If
          sAllTokens = Mid(sAllTokens, iCurTokenLocation + nDelim)
          iToken = iToken - 1

'
' On Return:
'    sExtractToken
'       Token # nToken
'    sOrigStr
'       Token # (1 through nToken-1) & (nToken+1 through nTokenCount(sOrigStr))
'
' Notes:
'    Yes there are a lot of "Exit Function" statements...
'       That's to make the function return as quickly as possible
'
Public Function sExtractToken(sOrigStr$, ByVal nToken%, strDelim$)

    Dim strIn As String
    Dim nCurrTokenStart As Integer
    Dim nNextTokenStart As Integer
    Dim nLenDelim As Integer
    Dim strOut As String

  ' Handle the "simple" cases (No delimiter, or token # less than 2)
    nLenDelim = Len(strDelim)
    If nToken < 1 Or nLenDelim = 0 Then
     ' Nothing to extract, return nothing
       Exit Function
    ElseIf nToken = 1 Then
       nCurrTokenStart = InStr(sOrigStr, strDelim)
       If nCurrTokenStart > 0 Then
          sExtractToken = Left(sOrigStr, nCurrTokenStart - 1)
          sOrigStr = Trim(Mid(sOrigStr, nCurrTokenStart + nLenDelim))
          Exit Function
       Else
          sExtractToken = sOrigStr
          sOrigStr = ""
          Exit Function
       End If
    End If

  ' Find the start of then nToken'th Token
    strIn = sOrigStr: strOut = ""
    nToken = nToken - 1
    Do Until nToken = 0
       nCurrTokenStart = InStr(strIn, strDelim)
       If nCurrTokenStart = 0 Or Len(strIn) = 0 Then Exit Function
       strOut = strOut & Left(strIn, nCurrTokenStart)
       strIn = Mid(strIn, nCurrTokenStart + nLenDelim)

     ' Check to see if this is the one the calling function is looking for
       nToken = nToken - 1
    Loop

  ' Now we're at the point" & gsWhere & "the token sought for resides
    nCurrTokenStart = InStr(strIn, strDelim)
    If nCurrTokenStart > 0 Then
       If nCurrTokenStart > 1 Then
          sExtractToken = Left(strIn, nCurrTokenStart - 1)
       Else
          sExtractToken = ""
       End If
     ' Rewrite the original string without the last token
       sOrigStr = Trim(strOut & Mid(strIn, nCurrTokenStart + nLenDelim))
       Exit Function
    Else
       sExtractToken = strIn
       sOrigStr = Trim(strOut)
       Exit Function
    End If
End Function

' Synopsis          Returns the Nth Token from sAllTokens delimited by sDelim
'
' Parameters
'
'   sAllTokens                 (I) Required. The string containing all the tokens
'   iToken                      (I) Optional. The index of the token to return
'                                   DEFAULT = 1

'                                   the tokens. DEFAULT = " "
' Description
'  For the following:
'    sAllTokens         iToken   sDelim  Returns       Notes
'   "William M Rawls"    1       " "     "William"      First word
'   "William M Rawls"    2       " "     "M"            Second word
'   "William M Rawls"    3       " "     "Rawls"        Third word
'   "William M Rawls"    4       " "     ""             No forth word
'   "William M Rawls"    0       " "     ""             Zeroth token is always empty
'   "William M Rawls"   -1       " "     ""             Negative tokesn always empty
'   "William M Rawls"    1       ""      ""             No delimiter ? Token empty
' ***********************************************************************************
Public Function sGetToken(ByVal sAllTokens As String, Optional ByVal iToken As Integer = 1, Optional ByVal sDelim As String = " ") As String
    Static iCurTokenLocation As Long ' Character position of the first delimiter string
    Static nDelim As Integer            ' Length of the delimiter string
    nDelim = Len(sDelim)

    If iToken < 1 Or nDelim < 1 Then
     ' Negative or zeroth token or empty delimiter strings mean an empty token
       Exit Function
    ElseIf iToken = 1 Then
     ' Quickly extract the first token
       iCurTokenLocation = InStr(sAllTokens, sDelim)
       If iCurTokenLocation > 1 Then
          sGetToken = Left(sAllTokens, iCurTokenLocation - 1)
       ElseIf iCurTokenLocation = 1 Then
          sGetToken = ""
       Else
          sGetToken = sAllTokens
       End If
       Exit Function
    Else
     ' Find the Nth token
       Do
          iCurTokenLocation = InStr(sAllTokens, sDelim)
          If iCurTokenLocation = 0 Then
             Exit Function
          Else
             sAllTokens = Mid(sAllTokens, iCurTokenLocation + nDelim)
          End If
          iToken = iToken - 1
       Loop Until iToken = 1

     ' Extract the Nth token (Which is the next token at this point)
       iCurTokenLocation = InStr(sAllTokens, sDelim)
       If iCurTokenLocation > 0 Then
          sGetToken = Left(sAllTokens, iCurTokenLocation - 1)
          Exit Function
       Else
          sGetToken = sAllTokens
          Exit Function
       End If
    End If
End Function

' Name              sReplace
'
' Parameters
'      sAll                          (I)  String
'      sFind                         (I)  String
'      sReplaceWith                  (I)  String
'
' Description
'
' Replaces all occurances of one string with another.
' ********************************************************************************
Public Function sReplace(ByVal sAll As String, ByVal sFind As String, ByVal sReplaceWith As String) As String
    Dim iCurFindPos As Long
    Dim iFind As Long
    Dim sOut As String

    iFind = Len(sFind)
    iCurFindPos = InStr(sAll, sFind)
    If InStr(sReplaceWith, sFind) = 0 Then
       Do While iCurFindPos > 0
          If iCurFindPos > 1 Then
             sAll = Left(sAll, iCurFindPos - 1) & sReplaceWith & Mid(sAll, iCurFindPos + iFind)
          Else
             sAll = sReplaceWith & Mid(sAll, iCurFindPos + iFind)
          End If
          iCurFindPos = InStr(sAll, sFind)
       Loop
       sReplace = sAll
    Else
       Do While iCurFindPos > 0
          If iCurFindPos > 1 Then
             sOut = sOut & Left(sAll, iCurFindPos - 1) & sReplaceWith
             sAll = Mid(sAll, iCurFindPos + iFind)
          Else
             sOut = sOut & sReplaceWith
             sAll = Mid(sAll, iCurFindPos + iFind)
          End If
          iCurFindPos = InStr(sAll, sFind)
       Loop
       
       sReplace = sOut & sAll
    End If
End Function

Public Function sExcept(ByVal sAllTokens As String, Optional ByVal iToken As Integer = 1, Optional ByVal sDelim As String = " ") As String
    Static iCurTokenLocation As Long ' Character position of the first delimiter string
    Static nDelim As Integer            ' Length of the delimiter string

Public Sub Load(sFilename As String, Optional bClearFirst As Boolean = True)
    If Len(sFilename) = 0 Then

    End If

    Dim fh As Integer
    Dim sLine As String
    Dim CurAssocArray As CAssocArray

    fh = FreeFile

    If bClearFirst = True Then
       Clear
    End If
    
    Open sFilename For Input Access Read As #fh
         Do Until EOF(fh)
            Line Input #fh, sLine
            If Len(sLine) = 0 Then
             ' Skip it
            ElseIf Left(sLine, 1) = "[" Then
               Set CurAssocArray = Add(Mid(sLine, 2, Len(sLine) - 2))
               With CurAssocArray
                    Line Input #fh, sLine
                        .ItemDelimiter = sAfter(sDenormalize(sLine), 1, "=")
                    Line Input #fh, sLine
                        .KeyValueDelimiter = sAfter(sDenormalize(sLine), 1, "=")
                    Line Input #fh, sLine
                        .FieldDelimiter = sAfter(sDenormalize(sLine), 1, "=")
               End With
            Else
               CurAssocArray.Add sGetToken(sLine, 1, "="), sAfter(sLine, 1, "=")
            End If
         Loop
    Close #fh
    Set CurAssocArray = Nothing

    Dim sOldItem As String
    Dim sOldKV As String

    Open sFilename For Output Access Write As #fh
         For Each CurAssocArray In mCol
             With CurAssocArray

                  sOldKV = .KeyValueDelimiter

Public Function BinToHex(bytes() As Byte) As String
    Dim saForString As SAFEARRAY1D
    Dim saForBytes As SAFEARRAY1D

    Dim saPtrForBytes As Long
    Dim psaForString() As Long
    Dim lCount As Long

  ' Get the safearray data for the passed in array. This gives us a fast
  ' mechanism to look at the dims, lower bound, and element count of the array.
    CopyMemory saPtrForBytes, ByVal VarPtrArray(bytes), 4
    CopyMemory saForBytes, ByVal saPtrForBytes, Len(saForBytes)
    
    With saForBytes
         If .cDims <> 1 Then Err.Raise 5

       ' Normalize the lower bound to 0, save calculations in loop
         If .Bounds(0).lLBound Then
            CopyMemory ByVal UnsignedAdd(saPtrForBytes, 20), 0&, 4
         End If

         If Not m_fInit Then
            CopyMemory m_psaHexPairs(0), ByVal StrPtr(cstrHexPairs), LenB(cstrHexPairs)
            m_fInit = True
         End If

       ' Allocate returned string array directly into name of function
         BinToHex = String(.Bounds(0).cElements * 2, 0)

       ' Setup safearray pointing to string we just allocated
         With saForString
              .cbElements = 4
              .cDims = 1
              .pvData = StrPtr(BinToHex)
         End With
         saForString.Bounds(0).cElements = .Bounds(0).cElements
         CopyMemory ByVal VarPtrArray(psaForString), VarPtr(saForString), 4

       ' Do the actual work to copy the hex bytes across
         lCount = .Bounds(0).cElements
         Do While lCount
            lCount = lCount - 1
            psaForString(lCount) = m_psaHexPairs(bytes(lCount))
         Loop
         
       ' NULL out array pointer
         CopyMemory ByVal VarPtrArray(psaForString), 0&, 4
         
       ' Restore old lbound
         If .Bounds(0).lLBound Then
            CopyMemory ByVal UnsignedAdd(saPtrForBytes, 20), .Bounds(0).lLBound, 4
         End If
    End With
End Function

Public Function UnsignedAdd(Start As Long, Incr As Long) As Long
      ' Only works with positive increments
        If Start And &H80000000 Then  ' Start < 0
           UnsignedAdd = Start + Incr
        ElseIf (Start Or &H80000000) < -Incr Then
           UnsignedAdd = Start + Incr
        Else
           UnsignedAdd = (Start + &H80000000) + (Incr + &H80000000)
        End If
End Function

' ******************************************************************************************
' Name              sInsertSpaces
'
' Parameters
'      sToInsertInto                 (I)  String.
'
' Returns
'      String                        .
'
' Description
'
' Inserts spaces into a string. Spaces are inserted at each capital letter.
' Common words not to be capitalized are handled automatically (a, an, the, or,
' of). The sub string "ID" is handled specially and is removed. This function is
' excellent for labels.
'
' ******************************************************************************************
Public Function sInsertSpaces(ByVal sToInsertInto As String) As String
    Dim bytOriginal() As Byte
    Dim sWithSpaces As String
    Dim nUpper As Long
    Dim nCurrent As Long
    Dim nA As Byte
    Dim nZ As Byte

    bytOriginal = StrConv(sToInsertInto, vbFromUnicode)
    nUpper = UBound(bytOriginal)
    
    For nCurrent = 0 To nUpper
        If bytOriginal(nCurrent) >= 65 And bytOriginal(nCurrent) <= 90 And nCurrent <> 0 Then
           sWithSpaces = sWithSpaces & " " & Chr(bytOriginal(nCurrent))
        Else
           sWithSpaces = sWithSpaces & Chr(bytOriginal(nCurrent))
        End If
    Next nCurrent
    
    sInsertSpaces = sReplace(sReplace(sReplace(sReplace(sReplace(sReplace(sWithSpaces, " Of ", " of "), " The ", " the "), " A ", " a "), " An ", " an "), " I D", ""), "  ", " ")
End Function

Public Function LoadFormPosition(frmToActOn As Form, Optional ByVal bAutoCenter = True)
    Dim ProductName As String

       frmToActOn.Top = GetSetting(ProductName, frmToActOn.Name, "Form Position Top", frmToActOn.Top)
       frmToActOn.Width = GetSetting(ProductName, frmToActOn.Name, "Form Position Width", frmToActOn.Width)
       frmToActOn.Height = GetSetting(ProductName, frmToActOn.Name, "Form Position Height", frmToActOn.Height)
    ElseIf bAutoCenter Then
       frmToActOn.Left = (Screen.Width - frmToActOn.Width) / 2
       frmToActOn.Top = (Screen.Height - frmToActOn.Height) / 2
    End If

Private Function ISadAddin_ExecuteSoftCommand(II As CInsertionInfo) As Boolean
On Error GoTo EH_SADAddin_ISadAddin_ExecuteSoftCommand
    Dim bEOLAtEndOfLine As Boolean

    Dim lThisWrap As Long

    Dim Token2 As String

    With II
         If Not MySadCommands(.SoftCommandName & "*C") Is Nothing Then
            If MySadCommands(.SoftCommandName & "*C").IsInline Then Exit Function

            Select Case UCase(.SoftCommandName)
                   Case "TESTING"
                         MsgBox "Soft command 'Testing' executed."
                         ISadAddin_ExecuteSoftCommand = True

                   Case "ANOTHERONE"
                         MsgBox "Soft command 'AnotherOne' executed."
                         ISadAddin_ExecuteSoftCommand = True

                  'Case "X"
                  'Case "Y"
                  'Case "Z"
            End Select
         End If
    End With

Private Function ISadAddin_ExecuteSoftCommandInline(ByRef SoftVars As CAssocArray, ByVal sInlineSoftCommandName As String, ByVal sParameters As String, sResults As String) As Boolean
On Error GoTo EH_SADAddin_ISadAddin_ExecuteSoftCommandInlineInline
    Dim Template As CTemplate

    Dim bInlineCommandExecuted As Boolean
    Dim lParamCount As Long

    Dim sDefault As String

    Dim sVar1 As String

    If Not MySadCommands(sInlineSoftCommandName & "*I") Is Nothing Then

       Select Case sInlineSoftCommandName

                   ISadAddin_ExecuteSoftCommandInline = True

    Err.Clear

    Err.Clear

' Encryption function
Public Function Encrypt(ByVal Plain As String)
    Dim Letter As String
    For I = 1 To Len(Plain)
        Letter = Mid$(Plain, I, 1)
        Mid$(Plain, I, 1) = Chr(Asc(Letter) + 1)
    Next I
    Encrypt = Plain
End Function

' Here's the Decryption function:
Public Function Decrypt(ByVal Encrypted As String)
Dim Letter As String
    For I = 1 To Len(Encrypted)
        Letter = Mid$(Encrypted, I, 1)
        Mid$(Encrypted, I, 1) = Chr(Asc(Letter) - 1)
    Next I
    Decrypt = Encrypted
End Function

Public Property Get StreetAddress() As String
    'Returns Street Address built from Line1 and Line2 and Line3 concatenated together
    Dim strStreetAddress As String
    If Len(m_strLine1) > 0 Then
        strStreetAddress = m_strLine1
    End If
    If Len(m_strLine2) > 0 Then
        strStreetAddress = strStreetAddress & vbCrLf & m_strLine2
    End If
    If Len(m_strLine3) > 0 Then
        strStreetAddress = strStreetAddress & vbCrLf & m_strLine3
    End If
    
    StreetAddress = strStreetAddress

Public Property Let StreetAddress(ByVal i_strNewVal As String)
    'Sets all Address Lines for String
    Dim strAddress As String
    Dim intPosition As Integer
    strAddress = Trim$(i_strNewVal)
    
    intPosition = InStr(1, strAddress, vbCrLf)
    If intPosition > 0 Then
        Line1 = Left(strAddress, intPosition - 1)
        strAddress = Mid(strAddress, intPosition + 2)
        intPosition = InStr(1, strAddress, vbCrLf)
        If intPosition > 0 Then
            'Set Line 2
            Line2 = Left(strAddress, intPosition - 1)
            strAddress = Mid(strAddress, intPosition + 2)
            If Len(strAddress) > 0 Then
                'Set Line 3
                Line3 = strAddress
            End If
        Else
                Line2 = strAddress
        End If
    Else
        Line1 = strAddress
    End If

'Commit the current record and then advance to the next record

        m_rsParameters.MoveNext

Private Function ActionCommit(Optional ByVal i_bAutoAdd As Boolean = True, _
                                Optional ByVal i_bIncrementalResults As Boolean = False) As BeneMO.BMOResults
    Dim objCur%%Person%% As BMO%%Person%%
    Dim objResults As BMOResults    'our results collection
    Dim objCurResults As BMOResults 'results from a function we called
    Dim objCurResult As BMOResult   'some times we want to have the current result object so we can re-throw it
    Dim strTitle As String
    Dim strParameterValue As String
    Dim bTerminated As Boolean
    
    Set objResults = New BMOResults
    objResults.Initialize Me
'Find the correct Employee record for the current row in the parameters collection
    On Error Resume Next
    Set m_objEmployee = Nothing
    Set m_objEmployee = GetCurrentEmployee
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    'Now check for any errors
    If Err.Number = bioErrInvalidConfig Then
        'abort the commit: we can't look up %%Person%%s
        Set objCurResult = objResults.Add(bmoError, kstrErrInvalidConfigTitle, _
                                            kstrErrCOM, Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description)
        ActionResultsAdd objResults
        Err.Raise bioErrInvalidConfig, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", objCurResult.Description
    End If
    
    If Err.Number = bioErrInvalidInput Then
        'abort the commit: we can't look up %%Person%%s
        Err.Raise bioErrInvalidInput, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", FormatMessage(kstrErrCOM, Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description)
    End If
    
    'If there is no current employee then we can't import this %%Person%%
    If m_objEmployee Is Nothing Then
        'Get the parameter value which may be null or otherwise invalid
        On Error Resume Next
        strParameterValue = m_objKeyParameter.Value
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            strParameterValue = "(Null)"
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
        
        Set objCurResult = objResults.Add(bmoError, kstrErrEmployeeNotFoundTitle, _
                FormatMessage(kstrErrEmployeeNotFound, m_objEmployer.Name, m_objKeyParameter.Name, strParameterValue))
        'Add our results to the global collection so they will get back to the original client after the exception
        ActionResultsAdd objResults
                
        Err.Raise bioErrInvalidInput, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", objCurResult.Description
    End If
    
'Find the correct %%Person%% record for the current row in the parameters collection
    On Error Resume Next
    Set objCur%%Person%% = GetCurrent%%Person%%
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    'Now check for any errors
    If Err.Number = bioErrInvalidConfig Then
        'abort the commit: we can't look up %%Person%%s
        Set objCurResult = objResults.Add(bmoError, kstrErrInvalidConfigTitle, _
                                            kstrErrCOM, Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description)
        'Add our results to the global collection so they will get back to the original client after the exception
        ActionResultsAdd objResults
        Err.Raise bioErrInvalidConfig, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", objCurResult.Description
    End If
    
    If Err.Number = bioErrInvalidInput Then
        'abort the commit: we can't look up %%Person%%s
        'Add our results to the global collection so they will get back to the original client after the exception
        ActionResultsAdd objResults
        Err.Raise bioErrInvalidInput, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", FormatMessage(kstrErrCOM, Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description)
    End If
    
'if there isn't any %%Person%% record then add this as a new %%Person%%
    If objCur%%Person%% Is Nothing Then
        If i_bAutoAdd = True And m_bAllowAdds = True Then
            RaiseTrace FormatMessage("Adding new %%Person%% with %1 %2", m_objKeyParameter.Name, m_objKeyParameter.DBField.Value)
            'add the %%Person%%
            Set objCurResults = Action%%Person%%Add
            If objCurResults.MaxStatus <> bmoError Then
                'we suceeded to some degree so try to get the %%Person%%
                'Add result
                objResults.Add bmoSuccess, "New %%Person%% Added", "A new %%Person%% with %1 %2 was added.", m_objKeyParameter.Name, m_objKeyParameter.DBField.Value
                On Error Resume Next
                Set objCur%%Person%% = GetCurrent%%Person%%
                On Error GoTo 0
            End If
            'and add that results collection to our collection for this round
            objResults.AddResults objCurResults
            
            'now we have to process any fields that are not part of the ADD statement
            If objResults.MaxStatus <> bmoError Then
                Set objCurResults = Action%%Person%%Change(objCur%%Person%%)
                objResults.AddResults objCurResults
            End If
        Else
            'report this as an invalid %%Person%% in the result set
            objResults.Add bmoError, kstrErr%%Person%%NotFoundTitle, kstrErr%%Person%%NotFound, _
                            m_objEmployer.Caption, m_objKeyParameter.Name, m_objKeyParameter.DBField.Value
        End If
    Else
        'If there is one perform the change routine
        If m_bAllowChanges = True Then
            RaiseTrace FormatMessage("Changing %%Person%% with %1 %2", m_objKeyParameter.Name, m_objKeyParameter.DBField.Value)
            Set objCurResults = Action%%Person%%Change(objCur%%Person%%)
            objResults.AddResults objCurResults
        End If
        
'        'now check to see if this is a terminated %%Person%% in which case also run the termination routine
'        If Get%%Person%%Terminated = True Then
'            If m_bAllowRemoves = True Then
'                RaiseTrace FormatMessage("Changing %%Person%% with %1 %2", m_objKeyParameter.Name, m_objKeyParameter.DBField.Value)
'                Set objCurResults = Action%%Person%%Terminate(objCur%%Person%%)
'                objResults.AddResults objCurResults
'            Else
'                'report that we're skipping the termination
'                objResults.Add bmoInfo, "Skipping %%Person%% Termination", kstr%%Person%%TerminateSkip, _
'                                m_objEmployer.Caption, m_objKeyParameter.Name, m_objKeyParameter.DBField.Value
'            End If
'        End If
    End If
    
'store away the current results into the complete collection
    ActionResultsAdd objResults
        
'if incremental results is enabled then return this result set
    'build a nice title
    If objCur%%Person%% Is Nothing Then
        strTitle = FormatMessage(kstrCommitTitle, m_objKeyParameter.Name, "Unknown")
    Else
        strTitle = FormatMessage(kstrCommitTitle, m_objKeyParameter.Name, objCur%%Person%%.%%Person Name Property%%)
    End If
    
    'Make sure that the temporary results set is cleaned up
    If Not objCurResults Is Nothing Then
        Set objCurResults = Nothing
    End If

    'raise it back to our caller
    RaiseResults strTitle, objResults, i_bIncrementalResults
    
'Return the result set
    Set ActionCommit = objResults
    Exit Function
ErrorHandler:
    'Make sure that the temporary results set is cleaned up
    If Not objCurResults Is Nothing Then
        Set objCurResults = Nothing
    End If
    Set ActionCommit = objResults
End Function

Private Function ActionCommitAll(Optional ByVal i_bAutoAdd As Boolean = True, _
                            Optional ByVal i_bIncrementalResults As Boolean = False) As BeneMO.BMOResults
    Dim objCur%%Person%% As BMO%%Person%%
    Dim objResults As BMOResults    'our results collection
    Dim objCurResults As BMOResults 'results from a function we called
    Dim objCurResult As BMOResult   'some times we want to have the current result object so we can re-throw it
    Dim strTitle As String
    Dim bTerminated As Boolean
    
    'Note that we don't reset the results collection- we may be called to auto-commit a current data set
    
'Process each individual record in order
    m_rsParameters.MoveFirst
    While Not m_rsParameters.EOF = True
        On Error Resume Next
        'Call ActionCommit for the current record.  It will move the record pointer to the next record when its done
        Set objCurResults = ActionCommit(i_bAutoAdd, i_bIncrementalResults)
        On Error GoTo 0
        
        'We shouldn't need to do this because ActionCommit already did.
        'Add these results to the global collection
        'ActionResultsAdd objCurResults
        
        'and move to the next record
        m_rsParameters.MoveNext
    Wend
    
    'finally, return our composite result set
    Set ActionCommitAll = ActionResultsGet
    
    'and our resultset so it will be released from memory when no longer in use
    ActionResultsClose
    Exit Function
End Function

Private Function Action%%Person%%Change(ByVal i_obj%%Person%% As BMO%%Person%%) As BeneMO.BMOResults
    Dim objResults As BMOResults
    Dim objCurParam As BIOParameter
    Dim dtEffectiveDate As Date
    Dim strMessage As String

    RaiseSummary "Changing %%Person%% " + m_objEmployee.Account
    LogDebug "BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", "Action%%Person%%Change", "Called for %%Person%% " + i_obj%%Person%%.%%Person Name Property%%

'perform initial setup work
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    Set objResults = New BMOResults

'maul through the parameters one by one
    On Error GoTo ParamError
    'update all of the parameters one by one
    For Each objCurParam In m_objParameters
        If objCurParam.ParamSource = bioPSIntegrated And objCurParam.Bound = True Then
            Action%%Person%%ChangeParam i_obj%%Person%%, objCurParam, objResults
        End If
    Next
    
    'switch to terminal error handling
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    'If there are no errors then commit the changes to benemo
    If objResults.MaxStatus = bmoError Then
        RaiseSummary "Not saving %%Person%% " + i_obj%%Person%%.%%Person Name Property%% + " due to error(s)."
    Else
        RaiseTrace "Saving changes to %%Person%% " + i_obj%%Person%%.%%Person Name Property%% + "..."
        i_obj%%Person%%.Save
    End If
    Set Action%%Person%%Change = objResults
    Exit Function
ParamError:
    'if we got here then we had a problem with a parameter
    strMessage = FormatMessage(kstrErrCOM, Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description)
    'Debug.Print strMessage
    objResults.Add bmoError, kstrErr%%Person%%ChangeTitle, kstrErr%%Person%%ChangeBeneMO, _
                    i_obj%%Person%%.%%Person Name Property%%, strMessage
    Resume Next
    Exit Function
ErrorHandler:
    'if we got here then we failed to add to BeneMO for some reason
    strMessage = FormatMessage(kstrErrCOM, Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description)
    'Debug.Print strMessage
    objResults.Add bmoError, kstrErr%%Person%%ChangeTitle, kstrErr%%Person%%ChangeBeneMO, _
                    i_obj%%Person%%.%%Person Name Property%%, strMessage
    Set Action%%Person%%Change = objResults
End Function

Private Sub Action%%Person%%ChangeParam(ByVal i_obj%%Person%% As BMO%%Person%%, _
                                        ByVal i_objParam As BIOParameter, _
                                        ByVal i_objResults As BMOResults)
    Dim objResults As BMOResults
    Dim objCurEEVersion As BMOEmployeeVersion
    Dim dtEffectiveDate As Date
    Dim strMessage As String
    Dim vtCurValue As Variant
    Dim vtParamValue As Variant
    
    'if the input parameter has information then start checking it
    vtParamValue = vbNull
    On Error Resume Next
    vtParamValue = i_objParam.Value
    On Error GoTo 0
    If vtParamValue <> vbNull Then
    'there is information.  Now we need to decide if we have that information or not
    'get the effective date for this information
        dtEffectiveDate = GetEffectiveDate(i_objParam)
    'Get the EE version that was in effect at the time of the change
        On Error Resume Next
        Set objCurEEVersion = m_objEmployer.Versions(dtEffectiveDate)
        On Error GoTo 0
        
    'safety check to make sure we got a version
        If objCurEEVersion Is Nothing Then
            'BUGBUG: we didn't find any version effective during the change, so this is behind our history of
            'the person.  What do we do now?
            i_objResults.Add bmoWarning, "No applicable %%Person%% Version", "There is no version old enough to have the effective date necessary for this change, skipping..."
            'how about this: use the first version we have
            Set objCurEEVersion = m_objEmployer.Versions(1)
        End If

    'See if it has the same value already
        vtCurValue = GetBeneMOValue(i_objParam, objCurEEVersion)
        If i_objParam.Value = vtCurValue Then
        'nothing to do; the value is already there
            strMessage = FormatMessage(kstrSuccessNoChange, objCurEEVersion.FullName, i_obj%%Person%%.%%Person Name Property%%, i_objParam.Name, i_objParam.Value)
            RaiseTrace strMessage
            LogDebug "BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", "Action%%Person%%Change", strMessage
        Else
        'it doesn't; we have to make a change.  In this case we don't need a new version because this data isn't versioned
            strMessage = FormatMessage(kstrSuccessChange, objCurEEVersion.FullName, i_obj%%Person%%.%%Person Name Property%%, i_objParam.Name, i_objParam.Value)
            RaiseSummary strMessage
            LogDebug "BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", "Action%%Person%%Change", strMessage
            'do the change
            SetBeneMOValue i_objParam, objCurEEVersion
            'add that we did it successfully to the results
            i_objResults.Add bmoSuccess, i_objParam.Name + " Changed", kstrSuccessChange, objCurEEVersion.FullName, i_obj%%Person%%.%%Person Name Property%%, i_objParam.Name, i_objParam.Value
        End If
    End If
End Sub

Private Function ActionExportNode() As XMLNode
    Dim objXMLNode As XMLNode
    Dim objCurXMLNode As XMLNode
    Dim strKeyParameterName As String
    Dim strEffectiveDateParamName As String
    Dim strEmployerName As String

    Set objXMLNode = New XMLNode
    
    With objXMLNode
        'set our tag for the top tag
        .Tag = kXMLIterator
    
        'add our properties
        .Add kXMLProgID, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator"
        .Add kXMLName, m_strName
        .Add kXMLAutoCommit, CStr(m_bAutoCommit)
        
        If Not m_objKeyParameter Is Nothing Then
            strKeyParameterName = m_objKeyParameter.Name
        End If
        .Add kXMLKeyParameter, strKeyParameterName
         
        If Not m_objEffectiveDateParam Is Nothing Then
            strEffectiveDateParamName = m_objKeyParameter.Name
        End If
        .Add kXMLEffectiveDate, strEffectiveDateParamName
       
        If Not m_objEmployer Is Nothing Then
            strEmployerName = m_objEmployer.Name
        End If
        .Add kXMLEmployer, strEmployerName
        
        'now add sub-objects
        If Not m_objDataSource Is Nothing Then
            Set objCurXMLNode = New XMLNode
            objCurXMLNode.ImportString m_objDataSource.Export
            .AddChild objCurXMLNode
        End If
        
        If Not m_objParameters Is Nothing Then
            Set objCurXMLNode = New XMLNode
            objCurXMLNode.ImportString m_objParameters.Export
            .AddChild objCurXMLNode
        End If
        
        If Not m_objDomains Is Nothing Then
            Set objCurXMLNode = New XMLNode
            objCurXMLNode.ImportString m_objDomains.Export
            .AddChild objCurXMLNode
        End If
        
    End With
    Set ActionExportNode = objXMLNode
End Function

Private Sub ActionImportNode(ByVal i_objXMLNode As XMLNode)
    Dim objCurNode As XMLNode
    Dim strDataSourceProgID As String
    Dim strIteratorProgID As String
    Dim strKeyParameterName As String
    Dim strEffectiveDateParamName As String
    Dim strEmployerName As String
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
'Set our own configuration
    'Verify that our tag is at the top of the configuration we got
    If i_objXMLNode.Tag <> kXMLIterator Then
        'raise error that this is not an iterator
        Err.Raise bioErrInvalidConfig, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", FormatMessage(kstrErrInvalidConfig, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", kXMLIterator, i_objXMLNode.Tag)
    End If
    
    'check that it's our ProgID for the object specified for this iterator
    strIteratorProgID = GetConfigItem("BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", i_objXMLNode, kXMLProgID)
    If strIteratorProgID <> "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator" Then
        'raise error that this is not the correct object
        Err.Raise bioErrInvalidObject, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", FormatMessage(kstrErrInvalidObject, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", strIteratorProgID)
    End If
    
    'Now start importing our configuration
    m_strName = GetConfigItem("BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", i_objXMLNode, kXMLName)
    m_bAutoCommit = CBool(GetConfigItem("BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", i_objXMLNode, kXMLAutoCommit))
    
    'we need to find our key parameter from the configuration file
    strKeyParameterName = GetConfigItem("BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", i_objXMLNode, kXMLKeyParameter)
    
    If Len(strKeyParameterName) > 0 Then
        'look up and set the key parameter object
        Set m_objKeyParameter = m_objParameters(strKeyParameterName)
    End If
    
    'we need to find our effective date parameter from the configuration file
    strEffectiveDateParamName = GetConfigItem("BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", i_objXMLNode, kXMLEffectiveDate)
    
    If Len(strEffectiveDateParamName) > 0 Then
        'look up and set the key parameter object
        Set m_objEffectiveDateParam = m_objParameters(strEffectiveDateParamName)
    End If
    
    'Now go and find the Employer for this action
    On Error Resume Next
    Set objCurNode = i_objXMLNode(kXMLEmployer)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    If Not objCurNode Is Nothing Then
        'there is an Employer recorded- try to load it up
        On Error Resume Next
        Set m_objEmployer = m_objContext.Employers(objCurNode.Value)
        On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
        'clear the XMLNode so that subsequent tests will work
        Set objCurNode = Nothing
    End If
    
'Create child objects and import their configuration
    'Get the data source object information
    On Error Resume Next
    Set objCurNode = i_objXMLNode(kXMLDataSource)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    If Not objCurNode Is Nothing Then
        'now get its progID
        strDataSourceProgID = GetConfigItem("BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", objCurNode, kXMLProgID)
        
        'create the data source object
        On Error Resume Next
        Set m_objDataSource = CreateObject(strDataSourceProgID)
        On Error GoTo 0 'note that we are DISABLING exception handling at this point
        If m_objDataSource Is Nothing Then
            'we couldn't create it- raise an appropriate exception
            Err.Raise bioErrNoObject, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", _
                    FormatMessage(kstrErrNoObject, "BIOIterator", strDataSourceProgID, _
                        FormatMessage(kstrErrCOM, Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description))
        End If
        
        'Have it import its configuration
        m_objDataSource.Initialize Me, objCurNode.ExportString
        
        'and reset the XMLNOde so that subsequent tests will work
        Set objCurNode = Nothing
    End If
    
    'Get the Parameters object information
    On Error Resume Next
    Set objCurNode = i_objXMLNode(kXMLParameters)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    If Not objCurNode Is Nothing Then
        'Have the parameters collection import this configuration
        m_objParameters.Import objCurNode.ExportString
    End If
    
    'Get the Domains object information
    On Error Resume Next
    Set objCurNode = i_objXMLNode(kXMLDomains)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    If Not objCurNode Is Nothing Then
        'Have the parameters collection import this configuration
        If m_objDomains Is Nothing Then
            Set m_objDomains = New BIODomains
            m_objDomains.Initialize Me, ""
        End If
        
        m_objDomains.Import objCurNode.ExportString
    End If
    Exit Sub
ErrorHandler:
    'BUGBUG
    LogDebug "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", "ActionImportNode", FormatMessage(kstrErrCOM, Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description)
End Sub

Private Function ActionProcess(Optional ByVal i_rsInput As ADODB.Recordset = Nothing, _
                                Optional ByVal i_bAutoCommit As Boolean = False, _
                                Optional ByVal i_bIncrementalResults As Boolean = False) As BeneMO.BMOResults
    Dim rsInput As ADODB.Recordset
    Dim objCurResults As BMOResults
    Dim strTitle As String
    RaiseSummary "Starting to process..."
    
'Get the correct working recordset
    'if we weren't handed a recordset then we should ask the data source object for one
    If Not i_rsInput Is Nothing Then
        'we were handed one
        RaiseSummary "Using provided recordset instead of configured data source"
        Set rsInput = i_rsInput
    Else
        'we need to get one from the data source object
        RaiseSummary "Connecting to configured data source and getting input data..."
        m_objDataSource.Connect
        RaiseTrace "Opening recordset..."
        Set rsInput = m_objDataSource.OpenRS
    End If
    
'create a new results collection which is our ultimate return value
    ActionResultsOpen

'Set Up a  new output recordset
    'First create the recordset
    ActionRecordsetOpen
    
    
'and process each individual record
    While Not rsInput.EOF = True
        'hand off processing of this record to the unit processor
        Set objCurResults = ActionProcessOne(rsInput, i_bAutoCommit)
        
        'add the results from the processor to our master collection
        'ActionResultsAdd objCurResults
        
        RaiseProgress "", rsInput.AbsolutePosition, rsInput.RecordCount
        
        'If incremental results is enabled then pass this results set back to the engine.
        'If check is done in the subroutine
        'build a nice title
        On Error Resume Next
        strTitle = FormatMessage(kstrProcessTitle, m_objKeyParameter.Name, m_objKeyParameter.Value)
        On Error GoTo 0
        
        RaiseResults strTitle, objCurResults, i_bIncrementalResults
            
        'move to the next record
        rsInput.MoveNext
    Wend
    
'now clean up
    'close the input recordset out if we created it
    If i_rsInput Is Nothing Then
        m_objDataSource.CloseRS
    End If

'and return our results collection
    Set ActionProcess = ActionResultsGet
End Function

Private Function ActionProcessOne(ByVal i_rsInput As ADODB.Recordset, ByVal i_bAutoCommit As Boolean) As BeneMO.BMOResults
    Dim objResults As BMOResults, objCurResults As BMOResults
    Dim objCurParam As BIOParameter
    Dim objBIOContext As BIOContext
    Dim strName As String
    
'set up our context object
    'Add a new record to our parameters collection to hold this input
    m_rsParameters.AddNew
    RaiseTrace "Processing Record " + CStr(m_rsParameters.RecordCount)
    
    RaiseTrace "Creating new context object for this element..."
    Set objBIOContext = New BIOContext
    'initialize the context
    objBIOContext.Initialize m_objContext, i_rsInput, "", "", "", "", "", ""
    
'Process each parameter (default translations)
    For Each objCurParam In m_objParameters
        RaiseTrace "Processing parameter " + objCurParam.Name
        objCurParam.Transform objBIOContext
    Next
    
'Process scripts for this record
    'BUGBUG: Not implemented

'Report what we're doing
    strName = CStr(GetParamValue(m_objKeyParameter.Name))
    RaiseSummary "Finished processing " + strName + "..."
    
'Get the results collection from the context
    Set objResults = objBIOContext.Results
    
    
    'if autocommit was enabled the call our commit function
    If i_bAutoCommit = True And objResults.MaxStatus < bmoError Then
        Set objCurResults = ActionCommit(True)  'we always auto-add
        objResults.AddResults objCurResults
        Set objCurResults = Nothing
    End If
    
'and teardown our context.  Note that we are relying on the fact that we've already set
'objResults so the results collection won't be released even after it's torn down.  Note that
'we have to do this after we try to commit the record otherwise the results collection is readonly.
    objBIOContext.Teardown
    
'Return the results collection
    Set ActionProcessOne = objResults
End Function

Private Sub ActionRecordsetClose()
    If Not m_rsParameters Is Nothing Then

        m_rsParameters.Close

    m_objParameters.UnBind

    m_objParameters.Bind m_rsParameters

'based on the key parameter we want to find any existing %%Person%%.
'This only works when there is a current open result set
Private Function GetCurrent%%Person%%() As BMO%%Person%%
    Dim objCur%%Person%% As BMO%%Person%%
    Dim objEEVersion    As BMOEmployeeVersion
    Dim bFound          As Boolean
    Dim strFound        As String
    
    'get the correct employee version to use
    Set objEEVersion = GetCurrentEmployeeVersion

    'Start looking: first for SSN, next for Birthdate then First Name then fail

    'See if we find one by SSN
    strFound = kstrParamSSN
    For Each objCur%%Person%% In objEEVersion.%%Person%%s
        If objCur%%Person%%.SSN = GetParamValue(kstrParamSSN) Then
           bFound = True
           Exit For
        End If
    Next objCur%%Person%%

    If bFound = False Then
        'See if we find one by birthdate
        strFound = kstrParamBirthDate
        For Each objCur%%Person%% In objEEVersion.%%Person%%s
            If objCur%%Person%%.BirthDate = GetParamValue(kstrParamBirthDate) Then
               bFound = True
               Exit For
            End If
        Next objCur%%Person%%
    End If

    If bFound = False Then
        'See if we find one by birthdate
        strFound = kstrParamFirstName
        For Each objCur%%Person%% In objEEVersion.%%Person%%s
            If objCur%%Person%%.First = GetParamValue(kstrParamFirstName) Then
               bFound = True
               Exit For
            End If
        Next objCur%%Person%%
    End If

    'if we did, see if the first name matches
    If Not objCur%%Person%% Is Nothing Then
       If objCur%%Person%%.First = GetParamValue(kstrParamFirstName) Then
          Set GetCurrent%%Person%% = objCur%%Person%%
       Else
          'if not even close, not found.
          Err.Raise bioErrItemNotFound, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", _
                FormatMessage("Unable to find the current %%Person%% because the First name of the %%Person%% found by %1 did not match the First Name of input %%Person%%", strFound)
       End If
    Else
       'if not even close, not found.
       Err.Raise bioErrItemNotFound, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", _
             FormatMessage("Unable to find the current %%Person%% by SSN, Birth date, or First name")
    End If
End Function

'based on the key parameter we want to find any existing employee.  This only works
'when there is a current open result set
Private Function GetCurrentEmployee() As BMOEmployee
    Dim objCurEmployee As BMOEmployee
    
    If m_objKeyParameter Is Nothing Then
        Err.Raise bioErrInvalidConfig, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", _
            "Unable to find employees in Benelogic because no key parameter was provided."
    ElseIf m_objKeyParameter.DBField Is Nothing Then
        Err.Raise bioErrInvalidInput, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%4Iterator", _
            "Unable to find employee in benelogic because there is no result set bound to the parameters collection."
    ElseIf m_objKeyParameter.DBField.Value = vbNull Then
        If m_objKeyParameter.DBField.Type = adVarWChar Then
           If Len(m_objKeyParameter.DBField.Value) = 1 Then
              Err.Raise bioErrItemNotFound, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", _
                  FormatMessage("Unable to find the current employee because no value was provided for the key parameter (%1).", m_objKeyParameter.Name)
           End If
        End If
    End If
    
    'there are only a few valid key parameters
    Select Case m_objKeyParameter.Name
    Case kstrParamERAssignedName
        For Each objCurEmployee In m_objEmployer.Employees
            If objCurEmployee.EmployerAssignedName = m_objKeyParameter Then
                Exit For
            End If
        Next objCurEmployee

    Case kstrParamSSN
        For Each objCurEmployee In m_objEmployer.Employees
            If objCurEmployee.Versions.Count > 0 Then
                If objCurEmployee.Versions(1).SSN = m_objKeyParameter Then
                    Exit For
                End If
            End If
        Next objCurEmployee

    Case Else
        Err.Raise bioErrInvalidInput, "BeneIO.BIO%%Prefix%%Iterator", _
            FormatMessage("Unable to find employees in Benelogic because the specified key parameter (%1) can't be used for this purpose.", m_objKeyParameter.Name)
    End Select
    
    Set GetCurrentEmployee = objCurEmployee
End Function

    dtEffectiveDate = GetParamValue(kstrParamEffectiveDate)

    On Error Resume Next
    Set objCurEEVersion = m_objEmployee.Versions(dtEffectiveDate)
    On Error GoTo 0

    'safety check to make sure we got a version
    If objCurEEVersion Is Nothing Then
        'BUGBUG: we didn't find any version effective during the change, so this is behind our history of
        'the person.  What do we do now?
        m_objResults.Add bmoWarning, "No applicable Employee Version", "There is no version old enough to have the effective date necessary for this change, skipping..."
        'how about this: use the first version we have

    Set GetCurrentEmployeeVersion = objCurEEVersion
End Function

Private Function GetEffectiveDate(ByVal i_objParam As BIOParameter) As Date
    'The real effective date is (in order of precidence) the parameter's effective date, the iterator date, or the current date.
    Dim dtReturnVal As Date, vtEffectiveDate As Variant
    
    'initialize to null
    vtEffectiveDate = vbNull
    
    'see if the parameter has an effective date override set
    If Not i_objParam.EffectiveDateParam Is Nothing Then
        'it does have one.  Does it have a value?
        vtEffectiveDate = i_objParam.EffectiveDateParam.Value
    End If
    
    If vtEffectiveDate = vbNull Then
        'we didn't find a valid date for the date param, continue with the local object
        If Not m_objEffectiveDateParam Is Nothing Then
            'we do have an effective date parameter.  Does it have a value?
            vtEffectiveDate = m_objEffectiveDateParam.Value
        End If
    End If
    
    If vtEffectiveDate = vbNull Then
        'it's still null so we failed to find it on the parameter or globally so use the current date and time
        vtEffectiveDate = Now
    End If
        
    'convert from the variant to a true date only
    dtReturnVal = DateValue(vtEffectiveDate)
        
    GetEffectiveDate = dtReturnVal
End Function

Private Function GetParamValue(ByVal i_strParamName As String) As Variant
    'check to see if the parameter value is there or not

Public Function CreateAllDirs(ByVal ToCheck As String) As Boolean
On Error GoTo errCreateAllDirs
  ' Recursively creates non-existing directories from the given path name
    Dim ToCreate    As String
    Dim CurrIndex   As Long

    Do While Not DoesDirectoryExist(ToCheck)
     ' Loop and parse through the string
       CurrIndex = InStr(CurrIndex + 1, ToCheck & IIf(Right$(ToCheck, 1) = "\", "", "\"), "\")
       If CurrIndex = 0 Then Exit Do

     ' Create the path name
       ToCreate = Mid$(ToCheck, 1, CurrIndex - 1)
       MkDir ToCreate
    Loop
    CreateAllDirs = True

ContinueAfterError:
    Exit Function

errCreateAllDirs:
    Select Case Err.Number
        Case 75 ' Ignore errors for existing paths
             Resume Next
        Case Else
             Resume ContinueAfterError
    End Select
End Function

Public Function DoesDirectoryExist(ByVal ToCheck As String) As Boolean
    DoesDirectoryExist = (Not (Len(Dir$(ToCheck)) > 0)) And (Len(Dir$(ToCheck, vbDirectory)) > 0)

Public Function FileList(ByVal sSpec As String) As Variant
    Dim nFiles     As Long
    Dim sFile      As String
    Dim vFileList  As Variant

    ReDim vFileList(1 To 10) As Variant
    sFile = Dir$(sSpec)

    Do While Len(sFile)
       nFiles = nFiles + 1
       vFileList(nFiles) = sFile
       If nFiles = UBound(vFileList) Then
          ReDim Preserve vFileList(1 To UBound(vFileList) + 10) As Variant
       End If
       sFile = Dir
    Loop

    If nFiles Then
       ReDim Preserve vFileList(1 To nFiles) As Variant
    End If

    FileList = vFileList
End Function

'the following private variables are for local user
Private m_bOverwrite As Boolean
Private m_strFileNamePath As String
Private m_strTranslatedFileNamePath As String
Private m_strCurrentFileNamePath As String

Private m_fsoFileSystem As FileSystemObject
Private m_obj%%Primary Output Property::TextStream%% As %%Primary Output Object Type::@Primary Output Property%%

'The following implement the variables for the standard BTXPartition interface
Private m_bAppendable As Boolean
Private m_bAppended As Boolean
Private m_bOpen As Boolean
Private m_objParent As BTXPartitions
Private m_strCaption As String
Private m_strName As String
Private m_lSequenceNumber As Long

Implements BTXPartition

Private Sub ActionAbort()
    'To abort we release any temp files and then indicate that we're not open
    If m_bOpen = True Then
        'close any temp file
        If Not m_obj%%Primary Output Property%% Is Nothing Then
            On Error Resume Next
            'close the %%Primary Output Object Type%%
            m_obj%%Primary Output Property%%.Close
            Set m_obj%%Primary Output Property%% = Nothing
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
        
        'and delete it
        On Error Resume Next
        m_fsoFileSystem.DeleteFile m_strCurrentFileNamePath, True
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
    m_bOpen = False
End Sub
Private Function ActionAppend(ByVal i_objPartition As BTXPartition)
    Dim objTextPartition As BTX%%Type%%Partition

    'step one: verify that the partition is of the same type as us
    If Not TypeOf i_objPartition Is BTX%%Type%%Partition Then
        ReportError btxErrInvalidObject, "BTX%%Type%%Partition.Append"
    End If
    
    Set objTextPartition = i_objPartition
    
    'verify that we can append
    If m_bAppendable = False Then
        'error- we're not appendable
        ReportError btxErrInvalidCommand, "BTX%%Type%%Partition.Append", "Object isn't a valid append target."
    ElseIf m_bAppended = True Then
        'error- we've already been appended to something else so aren't a valid append target
        ReportError btxErrInvalidCommand, "BTX%%Type%%Partition.Append", "Object has been appended to another object and isn't a valid append target."
    ElseIf m_bOpen = False Then
        'error-can't append to a closed partition
        ReportError btxErrPartitionNotOpen, "BTX%%Type%%Partition.Append"
    ElseIf m_obj%%Primary Output Property%% Is Nothing Then
        'internal error- we don't have a valid text stream to append with
        ReportError btxErrPartitionNotOpen, "BTX%%Type%%Partition.Append"
    Else
        'then add its file to our file
        m_obj%%Primary Output Property%%.Write objTextPartition.%%Primary Output Property%%.ReadAll
        
        'and mark it as appended
        i_objPartition.Appended = True
    End If
End Function
Private Function ActionCommit()
'to commit we close the file we created and then copy it to its ultimate destination
    If m_bOpen = False Then
        'raise an error- you can't commit a closed partition
    Else
        'verify that we have a text stream
        If Not m_obj%%Primary Output Property%% Is Nothing Then
            'Close the %%Primary Output Object Type%%
            m_obj%%Primary Output Property%%.Close
            Set m_obj%%Primary Output Property%% = Nothing
            
            'now copy the file we have to the new location
            m_fsoFileSystem.CopyFile m_strCurrentFileNamePath, m_strTranslatedFileNamePath, m_bOverwrite
        End If
        m_bOpen = False
    End If
End Function
Private Sub ActionImportNode(ByVal i_objXMLNode As XMLNode)
    Dim objPropertyNode As XMLNode

    If i_objXMLNode Is Nothing Then
        ReportError btxErrNullParameter, "BTX%%Type%%Partition.Import", _
                    "i_objXMLNode", "BTX%%Type%%Partition.Import"
    End If

    If i_objXMLNode.Tag <> kstrXMLTagPartition Then
        ReportError btxErrbadXMLTag, "BTX%%Type%%Partition.Import", _
                    kstrXMLTagField, i_objXMLNode.Tag
    End If
        
    For Each objPropertyNode In i_objXMLNode
        Select Case objPropertyNode.Tag
            Case kstrXMLTagProgID
                If objPropertyNode.Value <> "BeneTX.BTX%%Type%%Partition" Then
                    ReportError btxErrInvalidObject, "BTX%%Type%%Partition.ImportNode"
                End If
            Case kstrXMLTagName
                m_strName = objPropertyNode.Value
                
            Case kstrXMLTagCaption
                m_strCaption = Trim$(objPropertyNode.Value)
            
            Case kstrXMLTagAppendable
                m_bAppendable = CBool(objPropertyNode.Value)
                
            Case kstrXMLTagFileNamePath
                m_strFileNamePath = objPropertyNode.Value
            
            Case kstrXMLTagOverwrite
                m_bOverwrite = CBool(objPropertyNode.Value)
                
            Case Else
                'Do nothing to allow for future compatibility
        End Select
    Next
End Sub
Private Function ActionExportNode() As XMLNode
    Dim objXMLNode As XMLNode

    Set objXMLNode = New XMLNode
    objXMLNode.Tag = kstrXMLTagPartition

    With objXMLNode
        'start with the stuff common to all partitions
        .Add kstrXMLTagName, m_strName
        .Add kstrXMLTagCaption, m_strCaption
        .Add kstrXMLTagProgID, "BeneTX.BTX%%Type%%Partition"
        .Add kstrXMLTagAppendable, CStr(m_bAppendable)
        .Add kstrXMLTagSequenceNumber, CStr(m_lSequenceNumber)

        'now add stuff unique to us
        .Add kstrXMLTagFileNamePath, m_strFileNamePath
        .Add kstrXMLTagOverwrite, CStr(m_bOverwrite)
    End With

    Set ActionExportNode = objXMLNode
End Function
Private Sub ActionOpenPartition()
    Dim strFolderPath As String
    Dim strPathArray() As String
    Dim strTempFileNamePath As String
    m_bOpen = False
    
    If m_fsoFileSystem Is Nothing Then
        Set m_fsoFileSystem = New Scripting.FileSystemObject
    End If
    
    m_strTranslatedFileNamePath = TransformFileNamePath(m_objParent.Parent.Parent, m_strFileNamePath)

    'If overwrite not specified, check that file does not already exist
    If m_bOverwrite = False Then
        If m_fsoFileSystem.FileExists(m_strTranslatedFileNamePath) Then
            ReportError btxErrOutputFileExists, "BTX%%Type%%Partition.OpenPartition", m_strTranslatedFileNamePath
        End If
    End If
    
    'Get the Path info w/o the filename
    strPathArray = Split(m_strTranslatedFileNamePath, "\")
    strPathArray(UBound(strPathArray)) = vbNullString
    strFolderPath = Join(strPathArray, "\")
    
    If Not m_fsoFileSystem.FolderExists(strFolderPath) Then
        m_fsoFileSystem.CreateFolder strFolderPath
    End If
    
    'get a temporary filename in the temporary directory
    strTempFileNamePath = GetTempFileNamePath(vbNullString)
    
    Set m_obj%%Primary Output Property%% = m_fsoFileSystem.OpenTextFile(strTempFileNamePath, ForWriting, True)
    
    'and if we got here then all is good so store away the temp file name path as our current file and
    'indicate that we're open
    m_strCurrentFileNamePath = strTempFileNamePath
    m_bOpen = True
End Sub
Private Sub ActionWriteRecord(ByVal i_objRecord As BTXRecord)
    Dim strBuffer As String, strDelim As String, strFileType As String
    Dim objField As BTXField
    Dim strXMLStartTag As String, strXMLEndTag As String
    
    'Pull properties from the file specification
    strDelim = i_objRecord.Parent.Parent.Delimiter
    strFileType = i_objRecord.Parent.Parent.FileType
    
    'Start building the text record field by field
    For Each objField In i_objRecord.Fields
        'Allow for filler
        If strFileType = kstrFileTypeFixedWidth Then
            If objField.FieldStart > (Len(strBuffer) + 1) Then
                strBuffer = strBuffer + Space(objField.FieldStart - Len(strBuffer) - 1)
            End If
        End If
    
        'Append formatted field value
        
        strBuffer = strBuffer + strDelim + objField.FormattedValue
    Next
    
    If Len(strDelim) > 0 Then
        strBuffer = Mid(strBuffer, Len(strDelim) + 1)
    End If
    
    
    'set up additional XML wrapper tags
    If strFileType = kstrFileTypeXML Then
        strXMLStartTag = "<" + i_objRecord.Name + ">" + vbCrLf
        strXMLEndTag = "</" + i_objRecord.Name + ">"
        strBuffer = strXMLStartTag + strBuffer + strXMLEndTag
    End If
    
    'And finally add the buffer to the stream
    m_obj%%Primary Output Property%%.WriteLine strBuffer
    DoEvents
End Sub

Private Function ActionRunScript(i_objBTXContext As BTXContext, i_objScript As BeneMO.BMOScript) As Boolean
    Dim objHandler     As Handler
    Dim objInstance    As Object
    Dim strScriptName  As String

    m_bErrors = False
    If m_bDebug = False Then
        'Build the module name so future calls can correctly located
        'the already loaded and parsed in-memory module
        strScriptName = "*InMem" & Replace$(i_objScript.ID, "-", "")

        'get the handler for this script's Sub Main
        Set objHandler = m_colHandlers(strScriptName)
    
        If objHandler.IsModuleLoaded = False Then
            'load the module via _ReadMacro
            Set objInstance = m_saxScriptObject.ModuleInstance(strScriptName, False)
        End If

        'make sure the module loaded
        If objHandler.IsModuleLoaded = False Then
            GoTo BasicError
        End If

        'make sure the handled function (Sub Main) exists in the loaded module
        If objHandler.Exists = False Then
            GoTo BasicError
        End If

        'run the Sub Main()
        On Error GoTo BasicError
        objHandler.Call

    Else
        RaiseTrace FormatMessage(kstrExecScript, i_objScript.Name)
        With m_saxDebugControl
            .Code = i_objScript.Script
            .BreakPoints = i_objScript.BreakPointArray
            .Run = True
            DoEvents
            Do While .Run
                WaitAndDoEvents 10
                DoEvents
            Loop
            If m_bCancelProcessing = False Then
                i_objScript.BreakPointArray = .BreakPoints
            End If
        End With
    End If
    ActionRunScript = Not m_bErrors
    Exit Function

BasicError:
    m_saxScriptObject.ReportError Err
    m_bErrors = False
End Function
Private Function ActionExport() As String

    Dim objXMLNode As XMLNode
    Set objXMLNode = ActionExportNode
    'This pokes the additional child node onto the
    'exposed (friend) property of the parent engine
    m_objEngine.XMLNode.AddChild objXMLNode
    
    ActionExport = objXMLNode.ExportString

End Function
Private Function ActionExportNode() As XMLNode
    Dim objXMLNode As XMLNode
    Dim objCurXMLNode As XMLNode

    Set objXMLNode = New XMLNode
    
    With objXMLNode
        'set our tag for the top tag
        .Tag = kstrXMLTagIterator

        'add our properties
        .Add kstrXMLTagProgID, "BeneTX.BTX%%Prefix%%Iterator"
        .Add kstrXMLTagName, m_strName

        Set objCurXMLNode = New XMLNode
        objCurXMLNode.ImportString m_objSink.Export
        .AddChild objCurXMLNode

        Set objCurXMLNode = New XMLNode
        .AddChild m_objFileSpec.ExportNode
    End With
    Set ActionExportNode = objXMLNode
End Function
Private Sub ActionImport(ByVal i_strConfiguration As String)
    Dim objXMLNode As XMLNode
    If Len(i_strConfiguration) > 0 Then
        Set objXMLNode = New XMLNode
        objXMLNode.ImportString i_strConfiguration
        ActionImportNode objXMLNode
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub ActionImportNode(ByVal i_objXMLNode As XMLNode)
    Dim objXMLNode As XMLNode
    Dim strExpectedNode As String
    
    'Get the iterator information
    On Error GoTo ErrTagMissing
    strExpectedNode = kstrXMLTagName
    m_strName = i_objXMLNode(strExpectedNode).Value
    
    'Configure the TransFile object
    strExpectedNode = kstrXMLTagFileSpec
    m_objFileSpec.Import i_objXMLNode.Item(strExpectedNode).ExportString
    
    'Configure the sink object
    strExpectedNode = kstrXMLTagSink
    m_objSink.Initialize m_objBTXContext, i_objXMLNode.Item(strExpectedNode).ExportString
    
Cleanup:
    Exit Sub
    
ErrTagMissing:
    
    ReportError btxErrMissingXMLTag, "BeneTX.BTX%%Prefix%%Iterator", i_objXMLNode.Tag, strExpectedNode
    Resume Cleanup
    
End Sub
Private Sub ActionInitScriptEngine()
    'BUGBUG:Temporary
    If m_bDebug = True Then
        If m_saxDebugControl Is Nothing Then
            m_bDebug = False
        End If
    End If

    If m_bDebug = False Then
        If Not m_saxDebugControl Is Nothing Then
            With m_saxDebugControl
                If .Run = True Then
                    .Run = False
                End If
                .RemoveExtensions vbNullString
                .Shutdown
                .Disconnect
            End With
            Set m_saxDebugControl = Nothing
        End If

        Set m_saxScriptObject = New BasicNoUIObj
        With m_saxScriptObject
            .Initialize "2260-3241654-31"
            .EventMode = False
            .Trace sbtNone
            .BlockedKeywords = "Dialog GetFilePath InputBox MsgBox"
            .TaskbarIconMode = sbcIconNoneSysmenuNone
            
            .AddExtension "{}", m_objContext
            .AddExtension "{}", m_objBTXContext
            .AddExtension "Context.", m_objBTXContext
        End With
        ActionLoadModules
    Else
        If Not m_saxScriptObject Is Nothing Then
            With m_saxScriptObject

                    .Run = False

                .RemoveExtensions vbNullString

Private Function ActionLoadModule(ByVal i_objScript As BMOScript) As Boolean
    'BUGBUG:Temporary
    Dim strScriptName As String
    Dim objHandler As Handler
    
    On Error GoTo CancelActionLoadModule
    RaiseStatus "Loading Script '" & i_objScript.Name & "'"

    strScriptName = "*InMem" & Replace$(i_objScript.ID, "-", "")
    m_colScriptCode.Add i_objScript.Script, strScriptName
    Set objHandler = m_saxScriptObject.CreateHandler(strScriptName & "|Sub Main")
    If objHandler Is Nothing Then
        GoTo CancelActionLoadModule
    End If
    m_colHandlers.Add objHandler, strScriptName

    ActionLoadModule = True
    Exit Function

CancelActionLoadModule:
    Err.Raise vbObjectError, "BTX%%Prefix%%Iterator.ActionLoadModule", FormatMessage("Failed to load script '%1'", i_objScript.Name)
End Function
Private Function ActionLoadModules() As Boolean
    'BUGBUG:Temporary
    Dim objScript       As BMOScript

    Set m_colScriptCode = New Collection
    Set m_colHandlers = New Collection

    If TypeOf m_objTransmission Is BeneMO.BMOVendorTransSpec Then
        For Each objScript In m_objTransmission.Scripts
            If ActionLoadModule(objScript) = False Then
                GoTo CancelActionLoadModules
            End If
        Next
    Else
        For Each objScript In m_objTransmission.VendorTransSpec.Scripts
            If ActionLoadModule(objScript) = False Then
                GoTo CancelActionLoadModules
            End If
        Next
        For Each objScript In m_objTransmission.Scripts
            If ActionLoadModule(objScript) = False Then
                GoTo CancelActionLoadModules
            End If
        Next
    End If
    ActionLoadModules = True
    Exit Function

CancelActionLoadModules:
    ActionLoadModules = False
End Function
