Private Function ActionFireEvent(ByVal i_lEventID As bmoEvent)
    Dim objScript As BMOScript

    'Iterate the scripts collection and execute appropriate scripts
    If TypeOf m_objTransmission Is BeneMO.BMOVendorTransSpec Then
        'Just run Vendor Scripts
        For Each objScript In m_objTransmission.Scripts
            If objScript.ScriptEvent = i_lEventID Then
                ActionRunScript m_objBTXContext, objScript
                If m_bCancelProcessing = True Then GoTo CancelActionFireEvent
            End If
        Next
    Else 'BeneMO.BMOERTransSpec
        'First run Vendor Scripts then %%Item%% Scripts
        For Each objScript In m_objTransmission.VendorTransSpec.Scripts
            If objScript.ScriptEvent = i_lEventID Then
                ActionRunScript m_objBTXContext, objScript
                If m_bCancelProcessing = True Then GoTo CancelActionFireEvent
            End If
        Next
        For Each objScript In m_objTransmission.Scripts
            If objScript.ScriptEvent = i_lEventID Then
                ActionRunScript m_objBTXContext, objScript
                If m_bCancelProcessing = True Then GoTo CancelActionFireEvent
            End If
        Next
    End If
    ActionFireEvent = True
    Exit Function

CancelActionFireEvent:
    ActionFireEvent = False
End Function

Private Function ActionProcess(ByVal i_objEmployer As BMOEmployer, _
                               ByVal i_dtEffectiveDate As Date, _
                               ByVal i_bAutoCommit As Boolean) As BMOResults
    Dim objResults As BMOResults
    Dim objCurResults As BMOResults
    Dim obj%%Item%% As BMO%%Item%%
    Dim strTitle As String
    Dim lCurrent%%Item%% As Long

    m_bCancelProcessing = False

    If m_objEngine.ScriptEngine Is Nothing Then
        m_bDebug = False
    ElseIf TypeOf m_objEngine.ScriptEngine Is Control Then
        m_bDebug = True
        Set m_saxDebugControl = m_objEngine.ScriptEngine
    ElseIf TypeOf m_objEngine.ScriptEngine Is SaxBasicEntObj Then
        m_bDebug = False
        Set m_saxScriptObject = m_objEngine.ScriptEngine
    Else
        m_bDebug = False
    End If

    ActionInitScriptEngine

    RaiseSummary "Starting to process..."

    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    'TODO: Distiguish between the max and min dates based
    'on their purpose.  Currently, they are both being assigned
    'the effective date.
    m_dtEffectiveDateMin = i_dtEffectiveDate
    m_dtEffectiveDateMax = i_dtEffectiveDate
    
    Set m_objEmployer = i_objEmployer

    'we need to reset the BTXcontext before processing
    m_objBTXContext.Reset m_objEmployer, i_dtEffectiveDate
    
    'initialize our results collection
    Set objResults = New BMOResults
    objResults.Initialize Me
    
    If m_objEngine Is Nothing Then
        Set m_objEngine = New BTXEngine
    End If

    'open the sink
    m_objSink.OpenSink

    'clear any previously run attributes
    m_objBTXContext.Attribs.Clear
    m_objBTXContext.CurrentAttribs.Clear
    
    ActionFireEvent bmoOnTransmitBegin

    m_l%%Item%%Count = m_objEmployer.%%Item%%s.Count
    For Each obj%%Item%% In m_objEmployer.%%Item%%s
        RaiseProgress "%%Item%%", lCurrent%%Item%%, m_l%%Item%%Count
        lCurrent%%Item%% = lCurrent%%Item%% + 1
        ActionProcessOne obj%%Item%%, lCurrent%%Item%%

        objResults.AddResults m_objBTXContext.Results

        If m_bCancelProcessing = True Then GoTo CancelActionProcessNow

        'build a nice title
        On Error Resume Next
        strTitle = obj%%Item%%.EmployerAssignedName
        On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

        RaiseSummary "Finished processing " + strTitle + "..."
        RaiseResults strTitle, m_objBTXContext.Results, False
    Next

    If m_bCancelProcessing = False Then
        ActionFireEvent bmoOnTransmitEnd
    End If

    If m_bCancelProcessing = False Then
        If i_bAutoCommit = True And objResults.MaxStatus < bmoError Then
            Set objCurResults = m_objBTXContext.Sink.Commit  'we always auto-add
            objResults.AddResults objCurResults
            Set objCurResults = Nothing
        End If
    End If

    objResults.Teardown
    Set ActionProcess = objResults
    m_bCancelProcessing = False
    Exit Function

CancelActionProcessNow:
    RaiseSummary "Processing Cancelled."
    RaiseProgress "Processing Cancelled", lCurrent%%Item%%, m_l%%Item%%Count
    objResults.Add bmoFailure, "Processing Cancelled", "Exiting ActionProcess"
    m_bCancelProcessing = False
    objResults.Teardown
    Set ActionProcess = objResults
    Exit Function

ErrorHandler:
    objResults.Add bmoError, kstrErrProcessTitle, FormatMessage(kstrErrProcess, Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description)
    objResults.Teardown
    Set ActionProcess = objResults
    Exit Function
    
    Resume
End Function
Private Sub ActionProcessOne(ByVal i_obj%%Item%% As BMO%%Item%%, ByVal lCurrent%%Item%% As Long)
    Dim objDependent As BMODependent
    Dim lDependentCount As Long
    Dim lCurrentDependent As Long
    Dim objScript As BMOScript
    Dim strEmpName As String
    Dim strEmpSSN As String
    
    'Error here means that the employee has no Version effective on
    'or before the effective date.  Skip this employee.
    Dim lResult As Long
    RaiseTrace "Processing Record " & lCurrent%%Item%%

    On Error Resume Next
    
    'Grab info we'll be using several times building success results
    With i_obj%%Item%%.Versions(m_objBTXContext.EffectiveDate)
        strEmpName = .FullName
        strEmpSSN = .SSN
    End With
    m_objBTXContext.Reset%%Item%% i_obj%%Item%%, i_obj%%Item%%.Versions(m_objBTXContext.EffectiveDate)

    If Err.Number = 0 Then
        On Error GoTo 0
        ActionFireEvent bmoOnEETransmit
        If m_bCancelProcessing = False Then
            lDependentCount = m_objBTXContext.%%Item%%Version.Dependents.Count
            On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
            For Each objDependent In m_objBTXContext.%%Item%%Version.Dependents
                lCurrentDependent = lCurrentDependent + 1
                RaiseProgress FormatMessage("Dependent %1/%2", lCurrentDependent, lDependentCount), lCurrent%%Item%%, m_l%%Item%%Count
                RaiseTrace "Processing Dependent " & lCurrentDependent & " of " & lDependentCount
                m_objBTXContext.ResetDependent objDependent
                ActionFireEvent bmoOnDepTransmit
                m_objBTXContext.Results.Add bmoSuccess, "Dependent processed", FormatMessage("'%3' (%4) of '%1' (%2)", strEmpName, strEmpSSN, objDependent.FullName, objDependent.SSN)
            Next
        End If
    End If
    
    m_objBTXContext.Results.Add bmoInfo, "%%Item%% processed", FormatMessage("'%1' (%2)", strEmpName, strEmpSSN)
    On Error GoTo 0
    Exit Sub

CancelActionProcessOne:
    m_objBTXContext.Results.Add bmoError, "Processing Cancelled", "Exiting Process One"
    On Error GoTo 0
    Exit Sub

ErrorHandler:
    m_objBTXContext.Results.Add bmoError, kstrErrProcessTitle, FormatMessage(kstrErrProcess, Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description)
    Resume Next
End Sub

Function MembersCovered(ByVal i_objEnrollment As BMOEnrollment ) As String
	Dim objTestSpouse 			As BMODependent
	Dim objTestDep				As BMODependent
	Dim objTestEnrollment		As BMOEnrollment
	Dim bSpouseEnrolled			As Boolean
	Dim lNumChildrenEnrolled	As Long

	Select Case i_objEnrollment.Level.VendorCode
	Case "IND"
			MembersCovered = "%%Individual Coverage Code%%"
	Case "PC"
			MembersCovered = "%%Parent/Child Coverage Code%%"
	Case "HW"
			MembersCovered = "%%Husband/Wife Coverage Code%%"
	Case "FAM"
		'verify that they have a spouse and therefore the spouse is covered
		bSpouseEnrolled = False
		On Error Resume Next
		Set objTestSpouse = Context.Dependents(bmoDTSpouse)
		On Error GoTo 0
		If Not objTestSpouse Is Nothing Then
			'see if this spouse is actually registered
			On Error Resume Next
			Set objTestEnrollment = objTestSpouse.Enrollments(i_objEnrollment.Plan.ID)
			On Error GoTo 0
			If Not objTestEnrollment Is Nothing Then
				'they have a spouse enrolled
				bSpouseEnrolled = True
			End If
			Set objTestEnrollment = Nothing
		End If

		'Now check to see if they have multiple children registered
		For Each objTestDep In Context.Dependents
			'see if this dependent is a child
			If objTestDep.DependentType = bmoDTChild Then
				'see if this child is enrolled in this plan
				On Error Resume Next
				Set objTestEnrollment = objTestDep.Enrollments(i_objEnrollment.Plan.ID)
				On Error GoTo 0
				If Not objTestEnrollment Is Nothing Then
					'they are enrolled
					lNumChildrenEnrolled = lNumChildrenEnrolled + 1
				End If
				Set objTestEnrollment = Nothing
			End If
		Next

		If bSpouseEnrolled = True Then
			If lNumChildrenEnrolled > 1 Then
				MembersCovered = "%%Employee, spouse, and several children Coverage Code%%"
			ElseIf lNumChildrenEnrolled = 1 Then
				MembersCovered = "%%Employee, spouse, and ONE child Coverage Code%%"
			Else
				Context.Results.Add bmoWarning, "Unexpectedly Few Dependents", "There were no dependents enrolled in family coverage for this medical plan"
				MembersCovered = "%%Husband/Wife Coverage Code%%"
			End If
		Else
			If lNumChildrenEnrolled > 1 Then
				MembersCovered = "%%Employee and several children Coverage Code%%"
			ElseIf lNumChildrenEnrolled = 1 Then
				MembersCovered = "%%Parent/Child Coverage Code%%"
			Else
				Context.Results.Add bmoWarning, "Unexpectedly Few Dependents", "There were no dependents enrolled in family coverage for this medical plan"
				MembersCovered = "%%Individual Coverage Code%%"
			End If
		End If
	Case Else
		Context.Results.Add bmoError, "Unexpected Level encountered in 'MembersCovered()'. Level = " & i_objEnrollment.Level.Name
	End Select
End Function

Public Function Cubize(ByVal ToCube As String, ByVal ItemLength As Long) As Variant
    Dim StrLen      	As Long
    Dim CounterA    	As Long
    Dim StartCount  	As Long
    Dim LenDiff     	As Long
    Dim LenTest     	As Single
    Dim vtReturnArray	As Variant

    StrLen = Len(ToCube)                                 'get the length of our string
    LenTest = StrLen / ItemLength                          ' initialize LenTest

    StartCount = 1                                         'initialize StartCount
    If LenTest > Int(LenTest) Then LenTest = Int(LenTest) + 1    'we only want To work With Longs
    ReDim vtReturnArray(0 To LenTest - 1)                          'Size our array

    For CounterA = 0 To LenTest - 1
        vtReturnArray(CounterA) = Mid$(ToCube, StartCount, ItemLength)    'fill our array
        StartCount = StartCount + ItemLength               'increment our starting point in the Mid$ Function
    Next CounterA

    Cubize = vtReturnArray
End Function

Function WordCube( ByVal i_strToCube As String, ByVal i_lMaxLength) As Variant
	Dim strWork          As String
	Dim lCurrReturnIndex As Long
	Dim vtReturnArray    As Variant
        Dim strFiltered      As String

        'take care of special case expansions in addresses 
        'that cannot be correctly handled after WordCube
        strFiltered = i_strToCube
        strFiltered = Replace$( strFiltered, "&", " and ")
        strFiltered = Replace$( strFiltered, "#", " num ")

        'also translate new line characters, cariage returns, and line feeds to spaces
        strFiltered = Replace$( strFiltered, vbCrLf, " ")
        strFiltered = Replace$( strFiltered, vbCr, " ")
        strFiltered = Replace$( strFiltered, vbLf, " ")

        'insure no double spaces occur
        strFiltered = Replace$( strFiltered, "  ", " ")

	If i_lMaxLength >= Len(strFiltered) Then
		WordCube = Array(strFiltered, "")
	Else
		vtReturnArray = Cubize(strFiltered, i_lMaxLength)

		For lCurrReturnIndex = 0 To UBound(vtReturnArray)
			If (Right$(vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex),1) <> " ") And (lCurrReturnIndex <> UBound(vtReturnArray)) Then
				'Didn't break at the end of a word, fix it.
				strWork = vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex)
				vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex) = Split(strWork)

				strWork = vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex)(UBound(vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex)))
				vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex)(UBound(vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex))) = ""
				strWork = strWork & vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex + 1)
				'BUGBUG: Works only for 2 items which is fine for now
				vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex + 1) = Left$(strWork, i_lMaxLength)

				strWork = Trim$(Join(vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex)))
				vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex) = strWork
			Else
				'Broke at the end of a word or this is the last item, just trim it
				vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex) = Trim$(vtReturnArray(lCurrReturnIndex))
			End If
		Next
		WordCube = vtReturnArray
	End If
End Function
